items.prompt: To test shrinking bounds without copying the same control flow, which oracle is the most independent?

options.text: Rename top/bottom/left/right and paste the four loops.
options.why: Identical state and transitions can preserve the same boundary bug in both implementations.

options.text: Walk one cell at a time, track visited cells and turn clockwise when blocked.
options.why: This uses a different state representation and transition rule, useful for checking complete visit order.

options.text: Sort input and output tokens, ignoring coordinates.
options.why: This can test multiplicity but cannot detect a wrong spiral order.

options.text: Check only that the first output token equals the top-left cell.
options.why: A correct first token says nothing about missing, repeated or wrongly ordered later cells.

items.explanation: This uses a different state representation and transition rule, useful for checking complete visit order.
